Patterns in this selection

Observations you can trace back to agent runs

How are these numbers counted?

One agent run is one observed agent within its parent session, counted once in the selected scope. The period uses the run’s start date. Main and delegated agents are counted separately; forks remain distinct observed agents. Runs with several recorded models form a “Multiple models” group, and missing models or roles remain unreported. Percentages in Models used share the same denominator: all selected runs. These statistics describe retained evidence, not model performance, time worked, or spending.
